approach: Root cause: the reading gate fixes criteria from the request text, and no step compares each criterion with the defaults that govern how criteria are judged (D43: a behavior criterion's evidence is commands the verifier ran, within its grant; D115; the append-only rule for docs/decisions.md and records/). Fix it at the gate with one new check, `check_judging_rules` (surveys.rs), registered as the last `step!` in `refusing_check` (checks.rs). It reads only the parsed criteria and deliverables and costs no model call. Revision: (1) there is no whole-criterion exemption on words like 'refus*' or 'append*'. A decision id is refused as edited unless it is the object of amend/supersede/cite, and 'append a note to Dnn' counts as an in-place edit. A narrow meta-subject skip covers a criterion that describes another criterion. (2) Only commands the criterion cites to run are read: backticked spans that follow 'Run', 'Running', 'Execute' or 'Executing', or that open the criterion. Backticked mentions elsewhere are code behavior and are not read. (3) The command rule is a table mirrored from athena.toml `verifier_commands`, not an open denylist. The table decides cargo, git and ls, plus the programs the producer grant has and the verifier grant lacks. A unit test parses athena.toml with `athena_data::Config::parse` and fails when the table drifts. Passing the live grant into `refusing_check` would change the 5-argument signature that about 100 existing calls use (reading.rs:4322 and many more), so D174 records the table as interim, with the drift test as its guard. (4) A decision id needs a decision-log word in the same clause, so 'CHANGELOG.md is updated to name D174' is accepted. Wire in the corpus cases, tests, a 13th reader-rule line, D174 appended at the end of the log (amends D43), a decision-links entry and a CHANGELOG entry.

decisions.choice: Read commands only from the cited-run clause: backticked spans immediately after the word run/running/execute/executing (or opening the criterion), joined by ',', 'and', 'then', '&&', ';' or 'or'. Split each span into simple commands on `&&`, `||`, `;` and `|`. Spans elsewhere (for example 'the step runs `cargo fmt --all`') are unread. Answers finding 2.
decisions.reason: D43 judges the commands a behavior criterion cites as evidence (decisions.md:968-974), not commands the code under test runs. Athena's own format step runs `cargo fmt --all` (run/format.rs:5,71), and commits.rs:6 names `git merge --ff-only`. Criteria about them must stay accepted. This job's own criterion 1 names `cargo fmt` only inside a description, so it is accepted with no exemption.

decisions.choice: Judge a cited simple command against `VERIFIER_COMMANDS`, a constant table mirrored from athena.toml:76 and :108 (cargo: build, check, test, clippy, fmt, run, metadata, tree; git: status, diff, log, show; ls: *), plus `PRODUCER_ONLY_PROGRAMS` = rm, mv, chmod (the programs in producer_commands at athena.toml:74 that verifier_commands lacks). Refuse a cargo or git subcommand not in the table (cargo doc, install, publish; git commit, push), `cargo fmt` without `--check`, a leading `NAME=value` env prefix, a leading `env`, and a producer-only program. Do not read other programs: the existing accept tests use `athena status`, `status` and `athena start`, and the grant says nothing of them. Add a test `judging_rules_table_matches_athena_toml` that does `athena_data::Config::parse(include_str!("../../../athena.toml"))` and, for every capability, asserts that verifier_commands equals the table and that producer programs minus verifier programs equal PRODUCER_ONLY_PROGRAMS. Answers finding 3.
decisions.reason: The rule D43 enforces is the verifier grant, which is data in athena.toml. A table tied to it by a test cannot drift silently. It also covers cargo doc, which a denylist would miss. Passing the live grant into the gate needs a signature change across about 100 call sites (reading.rs:4322 and many more) and the replay path (replay.rs:55), which does not fit one producer run. D174 says the table is interim and names the signature change as the follow-up. The Reading has no grant field.

decisions.choice: Append-only rule, applied to every criterion of any kind. Words are lowercased text split on white space, trimmed of punctuation but keeping '/', '.', '-', '_' and with a trailing "'s" removed. Clauses are split on ';', ':', newline and '. '. In a clause, an id token is 'd' plus 1 to 3 digits. Refuse when the clause has a decision-log word (`docs/decisions.md`, `decisions.md`, 'decision' or 'decisions') and an id that is edited: (i) an edit verb (exact forms of edit, rewrite, reword, revise, modify, update, change, correct, replace, remove, delete, fix, overwrite, with their -s, -ed and -ing forms) within 4 words before the id; (ii) append/add (append, appends, appended, appending, add, adds, added, adding) followed within 4 words by to, onto, into or in directly before the id, with no 'new' in between ('append a note to D87'); (iii) the id followed directly by is/are/gets/was and an edit verb. The id is not edited if it is the object of amend, amends, amended, amending, supersede, supersedes, superseded, cite, cites, cited, citing, or 'refer(s) to' within 2 words before it. A clause with no id is refused when it has `decisions.md` plus 'in place' or 'existing entry/entries' plus an edit verb. A `records/` token is refused when an edit verb sits within 3 words before it, and none of 'from', 'read', 'reads' or 'reading' is in those words. Skip a match when a negation (not, never, without, no, unchanged) is within 3 words before the verb, or when one of the 3 words before the verb is criterion, criteria, reading, deliverable, text or rule: those clauses describe a criterion, not make an edit. Deliverables: any path under `records/` with any action, and Delete of docs/decisions.md, are refused. A Modify of docs/decisions.md is accepted. Answers findings 1 and 5.
decisions.reason: The cited 8gkv change is described by commit 620c657 'Stop pending-check merge refusals firing D87; append note to decisions' (HISTORY.txt:1095). Words like 'refusals' and 'append' are the topic vocabulary there, so a word-based exemption would let it through; rule (ii) refuses it. Requiring a decision-log word in the clause keeps 'CHANGELOG.md is updated to name D174' and 'the fix changes the behavior D43 describes' accepted. The meta-subject skip keeps this job's own criterion 1, which says 'a criterion editing an existing D87 entry in place', accepted without a topic-word exemption.

risks.risk: The matcher refuses a legitimate criterion, for example one citing a command as part of the feature under test, or one with a decision id near an edit verb in a criterion about another file.
risks.mitigation: Only cited-run clauses are read for commands. A decision id needs a decision-log word in its clause, and negation and meta-subject skips apply. The accept tests and accept corpus cases cover each shape named in findings 2 and 5. The error names the criterion and the repair.

risks.risk: Known misses: a git write command or gh/curl written in a non-cited position or with a program outside the table; a decision edit written without a decision-log word or without 'in place'/'existing' wording; an edit with more than 3 or 4 words between the verb and the path or id; a negation or meta-subject word used to dodge the check.

Refused criteria of any kind, including the 8gkv-modelled wording 'Merge refusals no longer fire D87: append a note to D87 in docs/decisions.md', 'Edit the existing D87 entry in docs/decisions.md in place', 'Rewrite D87 in docs/decisions.md to say X' and 'Correct records/jobs/x/outcome.json to say landed'. Refused deliverables: any action on `records/jobs/x/outcome.json`, and Delete of docs/decisions.md. Each case also asserts that a repaired text ('Run `cargo fmt --check`...', 'Append a new decision to docs/decisions.md that amends D87') is accepted. A further test `judging_rules_table_matches_athena_toml` ties the command table to athena.toml.
demonstrations.observes: Every refused reading gives Some("check_judging_rules") from gate_refuser. The error contains 'criterion N', the quoted criterion text and the repair advice (a command the verifier can run, or append a new decision that amends the old one). The drift test passes against the real athena.toml.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the `step!(check_judging_rules(reading));` line makes gate_refuser return None and the assertions fail. Removing the function makes the tests not compile. Changing a table entry makes the drift test fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry points: `check_judging_rules` in surveys.rs (added by step 1) and `refusing_check` in checks.rs:520 (step line added by step 2). Guard: capability must be Some, else Ok, like check_criteria_evidence at surveys.rs:92. Fixtures: the existing helpers `reading_with_criterion` (reading.rs:4461), `governed_reading` (:4558), `add_behavior` (:4705) and `gate_refuser`; the `Reading` is an argument, so there is no double. The drift test uses `athena_data::Config::parse(include_str!("../../../athena.toml"))` as at admission.rs:1083 and invocation.rs:378 (exists). A `judging_reading(kind, texts, deliverables)` helper is added by step 5.

demonstrations.method: Tests call `check_judging_rules` and `gate_refuser` on accepted shapes: 'cargo test passes'; 'cargo test --locked passes'; 'cargo fmt --check passes'; 'Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace`: all pass'; 'Run `git status --short`: no file under records/ appears'; 'records/ is not changed' (reading.rs:7108); 'the status line shows counts read from records/'; 'docs/decisions.md changes only by appending new text at the end'; 'The log gains a new entry D175 that amends D87'; 'Append a new decision to docs/decisions.md that supersedes D87'; 'Run `cargo test -p athena-core format`: the step runs `cargo fmt --all` before `cargo fmt --all --check`' (code-behavior mention); 'Run `cargo test -p athena-git`: the helper runs `git commit` and `git merge --ff-only`'; 'CHANGELOG.md is updated to name D174'; 'the fix changes the behavior D43 describes'; the exact text of this job's criterion 1 (a description with no exemption word); and the existing `Run `athena status`` and `Run `status`` texts. The accepted deliverables are `docs/decisions.md` (Modify) with CHANGELOG.md.
demonstrations.observes: check_judging_rules returns Ok for each text, and gate_refuser is not Some("check_judging_rules"). Existing accept tests that run `check_reading_acceptance(..).unwrap()` keep passing under `cargo test -p athena-core`.
demonstrations.fails_without: Over-matching fails them: reading every backticked span, refusing every Modify of docs/decisions.md, refusing any decision id near 'update' or 'change', or refusing any `records/` mention.
demonstrations.seam: Same production functions and in-file fixtures as criterion 1; nothing is injected. The `judging_reading` helper is added by step 5.

demonstrations.method: The test `every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case` (refusal_corpus.rs:2905) extracts each `step!(check_` line from `refusing_check` (via `function_body`, :2876) and requires a case in which that check refuses. Step 6 adds `judging_rules_cases()` to `cases()`, built with `case(..)` from `base_reading`. Refuse cases: `synthetic-class-of-7qht-cargo-fmt-without-check` (numbered `1.` parts); `modelled-on-620c657-append-note-to-d87-with-refusals-wording` (star bullets; docs/decisions.md added to `repo_files` so check_reading_references accepts it); `criterion-edits-existing-d87-entry-in-place`; `criterion-edits-records-file`; `deliverable-under-records-directory`. Accept cases: `criterion-runs-cargo-fmt-check`; `criterion-cargo-test-passes`; `criterion-mentions-cargo-fmt-all-as-code-behavior`; `criterion-appends-new-decision-amending-d87`; `deliverable-appends-a-new-decision`; `changelog-updated-to-name-d174`; `criterion-says-records-not-changed`. Input forms from the existing cases: `star-bullets`, `numbered-dot-parts`, `numbered-paren-parts-not-read-today` and `lettered-paren-parts-not-read-today`; the last two yield no criterion for this check. Seven tags are added to `INPUT_FORMS` (:90), changing its array size from 63 to 70: unrunnable-verifier-command, runnable-verifier-command, command-named-as-code-behavior, in-place-edit-of-existing-decision, append-only-file-appended-only, decision-id-in-criterion-about-another-file, records-path-edited. Behavior kind is set on criterion 0 as at :2022. I read these case ids and ran none.
demonstrations.observes: Every case gives its expected outcome. `every_acceptance_check_has_a_refusing_corpus_case` passes with `check_judging_rules` among the extracted names. `corpus_covers_the_listed_input_forms` (:2826) passes with the seven tags used. `an_extra_check_with_no_case_is_reported` (:2926) and `no_check_bypasses_refusing_check` (:3210) still pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the step line but no refusing case, the coverage test fails and names `check_judging_rules`. With the cases but no step line, the refuse cases get Accept and fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `athena_core::reading::refusing_check`, called by `run(c)` in the corpus file (exists). Fixtures: `case`, `base_reading`, `deliverable` and the per-case `repo_files` map (exist). The new cases and tags are added by step 6.

demonstrations.method: A content test modelled on `scope_limit_doc_and_changelog_name_the_cause` (reading.rs:8904) reads checks.rs and surveys.rs with include_str!. It asserts that `refusing_check` has exactly one `step!(check_judging_rules(reading));` line and it is last (after check_reading_references). It also asserts that the `check_reading_acceptance` doc links [`check_judging_rules`] and contains 'criteria are not tested against D43 and the append-only rules' with 20261024-045548-7qht and 20261102-005332-8gkv, and that the `//` comment above the step names the same cause and jobs. Also run `Grep step!\(check_judging_rules crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs`.
demonstrations.observes: One step line in last position, and the doc text, comment text and both job ids found.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the step line, the doc clause or the job ids the assertions fail.
demonstrations.seam: include_str! of the source files, as at reading.rs:8908 (exists). The test is added by step 5.

demonstrations.method: A test modelled on `records_measure_refusal_is_declared_intended` (refusal_corpus.rs:3138) calls `athena_core::reading::replay_declaration` on the 'expected 3% of newly refused readings' criterion text, on the doc comment of `check_judging_rules` and on the CHANGELOG item; each gives share Some(3). It also asserts that the changelog and D174 state 'higher refusal rate is intended' and call 3% an estimate, because the planner snapshot has no records to replay. The 3% is an estimate, not a measurement; the replay at verification measures it.
demonstrations.observes: A declared share of 3 in the criterion, the doc comment, the CHANGELOG item and D174.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the doc, changelog or D174 omit the declaration, the replay holds the job over its newly-refused limit and this test fails.
demonstrations.seam: Production function `replay_declaration` (exists, called at refusal_corpus.rs:3140). Doc text via include_str! as at :3152. The test is added by step 6.

demonstrations.method: Step 4 adds the 13th `READING_RULES` line in reader.rs (array type `[&str; 13]`), naming `check_judging_rules`, D43 and 'append'. The test at briefs.rs:3625-3713 now expects 13 lines, adds the check name to its list and asserts the new line's content. It keeps the 220-byte line cap and the section bounds. Also run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` for `budget reader: 1998 of 2000`, which is unchanged because the list is outside BudgetSet::Reader (lib.rs:285).
demonstrations.observes: The reader brief shows 13 rule lines, one naming check_judging_rules. Section bytes are within the bounds. The budgets test passes.

demonstrations.seam: Production entry point `reader_brief`, with the test's own `reader_inputs(&reading())` fixture (exists, used at briefs.rs:3626).

demonstrations.method: Run the three checks Athena runs on the result: `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`. The test run includes the decisions guard (`the_decision_log_is_well_formed_and_only_appended_to`, decisions.rs:247), the decision-link tests (decisions.rs:413-414, :483), the mirror rule (mirrors.rs:354), buy_first and ontology, the budgets test, the boundary scan (xtask/tests/policy.rs), and every test that calls check_reading_acceptance (reading.rs, replay.rs:55).
demonstrations.observes: All pass. D174 is the next id after D173, has a Provenance bullet and lies after the pinned bytes. Its single 'Amends D43' line number equals the new [[link]] line.
demonstrations.fails_without: A malformed D174, a wrong link line, a clippy warning, a format difference or a regression in an existing test fails the matching job.
demonstrations.seam: Existing test suites. The one fixture change is moving the `Run `git push`` text out of the loop at reading.rs:5089-5116 into its own test (step 5).

demonstrations.method: The guard `check_log` (decisions.rs:218) confirms the first 359622 bytes of docs/decisions.md still hash to the pinned value and that D174 is the next id. A content check by Read and Grep: CHANGELOG.md has a new bullet at the top of `### Added` under `## [Unreleased]` naming `reading::check_judging_rules`, the root cause, both job ids, 'higher refusal rate is intended', 'expected 3% of newly refused readings' and the refused and accepted examples. `git diff docs/decisions.md` shows only added lines at the end.
demonstrations.observes: The pinned prefix is unchanged, the new entry follows D173, and the changelog item is present.
demonstrations.fails_without: An in-place edit of any earlier entry changes the pinned prefix hash and fails the guard.
demonstrations.seam: Existing guard `check_log` (decisions.rs:218, exists). The files are edited by step 7.
